entries.title: Leviticus 3:1
segments: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace-offerings; if he offer of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:2
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it at the door of the tent of meeting: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:3
segments: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:4
segments: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:5
segments: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt-offering, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:6
segments: And if his oblation for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:7
segments: If he offer a lamb for his oblation, then shall he offer it before Jehovah;

entries.title: Leviticus 3:8
segments: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of his oblation, and kill it before the tent of meeting: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:9
segments: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat thereof, the fat tail entire, he shall take away hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:10
segments: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:11
segments: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:12
segments: And if his oblation be a goat, then he shall offer it before Jehovah:

entries.title: Leviticus 3:13
segments: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:14
segments: And he shall offer thereof his oblation, [even] an offering made by fire unto Jehovah; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 3:15
segments: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:16
segments: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a sweet savor; all the fat is Jehovah's.

entries.title: Leviticus 3:17
segments: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that ye shall eat neither fat nor blood.
